ticket.title: Release 0.1.0-beta.2: publish all twelve members to crates.io and tag the GitHub release
ticket.description:
Release 0.1.0-beta.2 across the workspace, publishing all twelve members to crates.io and tagging
v0.1.0-beta.2 on GitHub.

WHY BETA.2 AND NOT LATER
docs/ROADMAP.md section 5 names 0.1.0-beta.2 as the target for Milestone 5, whose exit criteria include
"MLAT TDOA solver verified against multi-receiver synthetic vectors" and "0.1.0-beta.2 tagged with
lockstep SemVer". Every item in that milestone is checked, and Milestone 6 (target 0.1.0-beta.3) is still
in progress, so beta.2 is the version the roadmap already promised for the work that exists.

MEASURED STATE BEFORE THE RELEASE, 2026-11-13
  crates.io: eleven members at 0.1.0-beta.1, all created 2026-11-04 except aerofoil-tui and
             aerofoil-replay (2026-11-10); the umbrella name `aerofoil` holds only the 0.1.0-alpha.1
             reservation placeholder, and no umbrella crate exists in this workspace
  aerofoil-mlat: FREE on crates.io - this release is its first publication

  aerofoil-mlat is implemented, not scaffolded: registry, clock-drift synchronisation, geodetic helpers,
  and a closed-form Bancroft TDOA solver over 502 lines, with four tests passing (receiver registry,
  WGS84 roundtrip over airports, Bancroft synthetic quad solve, insufficient-receivers error). It is
  consumed by aerofoil-server, so leaving it unpublished leaves a workspace member that cannot be built
  from the registry.

PUBLISH ORDER (intra-workspace edges)
  aerofoil-common, aerofoil-sdr
  then aerofoil-1090, aerofoil-978, aerofoil-mlat, aerofoil-persistence, aerofoil-tracker
  then aerofoil-server, aerofoil-cli, aerofoil-mcp, aerofoil-tui, aerofoil-replay

EXPECTED RATE LIMITING
crates.io allows a burst of five new publications inside a ten-minute window and returns 429 with a reset
timestamp. Twelve crates therefore need at least three windows; honour the reset header rather than
guessing a delay (the repository's own reservation script records the same lesson).

NOT IN SCOPE
Cutting 0.1.0-beta.3 for Milestone 6. This ticket moves the version the roadmap already assigned.
acceptance_criteria: all twelve workspace members resolve from crates.io at 0.1.0-beta.2, including aerofoil-mlat's first publication
workspace version, every intra-workspace pin, the Docker and Helm image tags, and the sdk/web package versions all read 0.1.0-beta.2
CHANGELOG.md promotes Unreleased to 0.1.0-beta.2 with the release date, leaves a fresh Unreleased heading, and carries the comparison links
docs/ROADMAP.md names 0.1.0-beta.2 as released and keeps 0.1.0-beta.3 as the Milestone 6 target
annotated tag v0.1.0-beta.2 exists on main and a GitHub release is published against it
